name: Windows core compliance
expectedDescription: Supported OS, BitLocker, Secure Boot, code integrity, TPM and antivirus required according to the approved release profile.
manualInstructions: Verify the approved OS release and security requirements. Local protection status does not prove recovery-key escrow or tenant compliance.

name: BitLocker and recovery escrow
expectedDescription: Recovery information must be saved to Entra ID before new encryption starts; silent encryption for standard users.
manualInstructions: Verify recovery escrow in the approved tenant and test recovery access. Do not start encryption until escrow prerequisites are confirmed.

name: Windows LAPS
expectedDescription: Entra backup; 20-character random passwords with four character classes; seven-day rotation; reset and log off the managed administrator 24 hours after use.
manualInstructions: Inspect effective LAPS settings, the managed account SID, rotation and Entra escrow/retrieval through the approved management tools. No passwords are collected.

name: Windows Hello for Business
expectedDescription: Windows Hello PIN minimum eight characters, lowercase letter required (1), digits allowed (0); digits-only PIN refused.
manualInstructions: Verify effective Windows Hello PIN/biometric policy and enrolment as the intended user; the toolkit does not enrol credentials.

name: Windows core restrictions
expectedDescription: Apply the core device restrictions and lock behaviour; avoid duplicate settings across profiles.
manualInstructions: Review effective device restrictions and screen-lock settings against the reference; resolve competing GPO/MDM sources through management tools.

name: OneDrive sign-in and Known Folder Move
expectedDescription: Silent account configuration and Known Folder Move for Desktop, Documents and Pictures; opt-out blocked; verified on a pilot device.
manualInstructions: Confirm the correct organisation/account is signed in, Desktop/Documents/Pictures are protected and sync is healthy. A profile key alone does not prove folder protection.

name: Microsoft Edge configuration
expectedDescription: Work account sign-in and the agreed browser settings; effective configuration verified on a pilot device.
manualInstructions: Verify effective Edge policies, work account sign-in, sync scope and browser behaviour. Presence of a policy key does not prove correct configuration.

name: Long paths
expectedDescription: Enable native LongPathsEnabled by default for the standard population.
manualInstructions: Confirm applications support long paths; the local Windows setting cannot change application compatibility. A restart may be required.

name: Windows web sign-in
expectedDescription: Windows web sign-in; ./Device/Vendor/MSFT/Policy/Config/Authentication/EnableWebSignIn = 1
manualInstructions: Verify Windows web sign-in prerequisites, policy and an approved sign-in test. Do not alter authentication providers locally.

name: Chrome single sign-on
expectedDescription: Built-in Chrome settings catalog: CloudAPAuthEnabled = true. No uploaded ADMX.
manualInstructions: Verify Chrome work-profile sign-in and approved single sign-on integration in the intended user session.

name: UK region and keyboard
expectedDescription: At setup choose United Kingdom region and UK keyboard. Engineers configure the Windows Welcome screen and new-user defaults manually.
manualInstructions: Verify UK formats and keyboard for the current engineer. Welcome-screen, default-user and other-user language settings require separate review.

name: UK time zone
expectedDescription: UK time zone; ./Device/Vendor/MSFT/Policy/Config/TimeLanguageSettings/ConfigureTimeZone = GMT Standard Time
manualInstructions: Verify the UK time zone and automatic time-zone management requirements. Time synchronisation is a separate check.

name: Show file extensions
expectedDescription: File Explorer > View > Show > File name extensions: on.
manualInstructions: Verify file extensions in a newly opened Explorer window for the current engineer.

name: OneDrive Files On-Demand
expectedDescription: Built-in OneDrive FilesOnDemandEnabled = 1. Keep cloud files available on demand and verify hydration with the user.
manualInstructions: Confirm OneDrive Files On-Demand is effective and files hydrate correctly for the intended work account. Policy presence alone is insufficient.

name: Storage Sense
expectedDescription: Storage Sense; ./Device/Vendor/MSFT/Policy/Config/Storage/AllowStorageSenseGlobal = 1
manualInstructions: Review Storage Sense settings and retention requirements. This toolkit does not delete user files.

name: Hide consumer features
expectedDescription: Hide consumer features; ./Device/Vendor/MSFT/Policy/Config/Experience/AllowWindowsConsumerFeatures = 0
manualInstructions: Review consumer-feature policy and user experience against the reference without removing business applications.

name: Taskbar starting layout
expectedDescription: Starting pins: Edge, File Explorer, Outlook, Teams, Microsoft 365 Copilot. No Word or Excel. Users can subsequently unpin.
manualInstructions: Verify the taskbar starting layout as the intended user. Existing user pins require separate review.

name: Microsoft Store available
expectedDescription: Microsoft Store is not restricted; approved store apps may be deployed.
manualInstructions: Open Microsoft Store as the current user and confirm required access. An installed package does not prove Store access is allowed.

name: Windows settings backup and restore (ESR successor)
expectedDescription: Windows settings backup and restore (ESR successor); ./Device/Vendor/MSFT/Policy/Config/SettingsSync/EnableWindowsBackup = <enabled/>
manualInstructions: Verify Windows settings backup/restore policy and account prerequisites in the approved tenant.

name: Fast startup off
expectedDescription: Power Options > Choose what the power buttons do > Change settings currently unavailable > clear Turn on fast startup.
manualInstructions: Confirm fast startup is disabled locally. Restart and managed policy behaviour require device acceptance.

name: No sleep on mains
expectedDescription: No sleep on mains; ./Device/Vendor/MSFT/Policy/Config/Power/StandbyTimeoutPluggedIn = <enabled/><data id="EnterACStandbyTimeOut" value="0"/>
manualInstructions: Check active power plan AC sleep is Never. Battery sleep and display timeout are not changed.

name: Remove consumer Copilot app
expectedDescription: Remove consumer Copilot app; ./Device/Vendor/MSFT/Policy/Config/WindowsAI/RemoveMicrosoftCopilotApp = 1
manualInstructions: Verify the exact consumer Microsoft.Copilot package and tenant assignment. Do not remove Microsoft 365 Copilot or other products.

name: Microsoft 365 Apps
expectedDescription: Microsoft 365 Apps for business, 64-bit, en-GB, Monthly Enterprise channel; assigned to GRP - Office Install Ready after ESP.
manualInstructions: Compare installed identity, version and publisher with the approved Microsoft 365 Apps deployment profile. Installation does not prove licensing, sign-in or vendor configuration. Supply approved media and deployment parameters.

name: Company Portal
expectedDescription: Company Portal deployed to the agreed Windows scope.
manualInstructions: Compare installed identity, version and publisher with the approved Company Portal deployment profile. Installation does not prove licensing, sign-in or vendor configuration. Supply approved media and deployment parameters.

manualInstructions: Compare installed identity, version and publisher with the approved Google Chrome deployment profile. Installation does not prove licensing, sign-in or vendor configuration. Supply approved media and deployment parameters.

manualInstructions: Compare installed identity, version and publisher with the approved Adobe Acrobat Reader deployment profile. Installation does not prove licensing, sign-in or vendor configuration. Supply approved media and deployment parameters.

name: OneDrive application

manualInstructions: Compare installed identity, version and publisher with the approved OneDrive application deployment profile. Installation does not prove licensing, sign-in or vendor configuration. Supply approved media and deployment parameters.

name: Microsoft Teams
expectedDescription: Deploy the approved Teams package and verify sign-in.
manualInstructions: Compare installed identity, version and publisher with the approved Microsoft Teams deployment profile. Installation does not prove licensing, sign-in or vendor configuration. Supply approved media and deployment parameters.

name: Remote management agent
expectedDescription: Use the client-specific installer and validate the device appears in the management console.
manualInstructions: Compare installed identity, version and publisher with the approved Remote management agent deployment profile. Installation does not prove licensing, sign-in or vendor configuration. Supply approved media and deployment parameters.

name: ESET endpoint protection (client package)
expectedDescription: ESET antivirus and EDR installed and healthy using the client-approved package and licence. No ESET installer or tenant secret is shipped.
manualInstructions: Compare installed identity, version and publisher with the approved ESET endpoint protection (client package) deployment profile. Installation does not prove licensing, sign-in or vendor configuration. Supply approved media and deployment parameters.
